name: Fajita-Style Pork Bowl with Bell Peppers, Onions, Kale & Lime Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
1 ½ bunches kale
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Trim, halve, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips; add to the baking sheets with the bell pepper.

Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips. Add to the baking sheets, sprinkle with ⅔ of the spice mix, then drizzle with oil; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining spice mix for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast until veggies start to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Add beans to the bowl with the kale along with oil and salt; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans black beans
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are soft, add kale and beans to the baking sheets; toss to combine, then return to the oven and continue to bake until kale is tender and pork is cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice limes into the bowl with the remaining spice mix; add yogurt and water, then stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp water

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pork, beans, and veggies between bowls; drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
